WELCOME TO PITHUBAR COLLEGE
Pithubar College, Khowang – A Legacy of Education and Empowerment Established on 9th August 1989, Pithubar College, Khowang stands as a beacon of knowledge, dedicated to providing quality higher education to students from underprivileged and socially marginalized communities, particularly those from tea garden backgrounds. Affiliated to Dibrugarh University and recognized under UGC 12(B) in 2018, the college was provincialized in 2013, solidifying its commitment to academic excellence and social upliftment.

Principal's Desk
Welcome to Pithubar College, Khowang a place where knowledge shapes futures, education empowers individuals, and learning transforms lives. It is both an honor and a profound responsibility to serve as the Principal of this institution, which has long been a beacon of hope and progress for students from diverse backgrounds, especially those from underprivileged and marginalized communities. Education, to me, is not just about imparting information; it is about nurturing curiosity, fostering critical thinking, and instilling values that build strong, capable, and compassionate individuals. At Pithubar College, we believe that every student carries within them limitless potential, and it is our mission to provide them with the right guidance, resources, and opportunities to unlock that potential.
